answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by bounding the transition probability matrix of a personalized EigenTrust walk across a sparse multi-agent grove. As adversarial identities form a disconnected nebula, spectral partition barriers enforce rapid diffusion decay, while slashing penalties ensure a robust Nash equilibrium where honest consensus dominates.
